bounded_host_request.command:
v=0
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 grep -Fq DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE /app/server/main.js || v=$((v+1))
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health >/dev/null || v=$((v+2))
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 sh -c 'test "$DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE" = model_gates' || v=$((v+4))
docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1 | grep -qx true || v=$((v+8))
exit "$v"
